name: No! body knows ~Sono Karada ga Shitteiru~
original_name: No! body knows　～その身体が知っている～
source:
"My parents aren't home today."

Minagi Ako, the protagonist's girlfriend, invited the protagonist over to be her "bodyguard" while her parents were away. Her parents would be away on a business trip for a few days... This was a clear OK sign for tonight, so the protagonist headed over to her house in high spirits.

She suggested for him to take a bath, and while the protagonist was in the bath, the bathroom door suddenly opened. In the depths of the steam, his beloved was standing completely naked. Both were in the mood, and all the conditions were met. Their bodies joined together. The happy consummation of a young couple...or so it seemed.

But then, the girl who had just lost her virginity, and only a moment ago had gazed upon him with moist eyes, suddenly changed. The corners of her mouth rose, and she murmured devilishly, "Serves you right, Ako (lol)."

The protagonist was shocked to find out that the girl was actually Ako's twin sister, Minagi Mio. Having seduced the protagonist from her older sister, Mio basked in the feeling of superiority. Conversely, the protagonist was dismayed at having mistaken the person he loves.

While living under the same roof, the younger sister secretly tries every trick in the book to seduce the protagonist. The older sister is puzzled by some things, but is excited about the idea of semi-cohabitation with her boyfriend. The days in which the protagonist tries to skillfully cajole the younger sister and to elevate his relationship with the older sister are about to begin.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/048/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
“我爸妈今天不在家。”

主人公的女友美凪亚子在父母外出期间邀请主人公来当她的“保镖”。她的父母要出差几天……这显然是今晚的好兆头，所以主角兴高采烈地去了她家。

她建议他去洗澡，就在主角洗澡的时候，浴室的门突然打开了。在蒸汽的深处，他的爱人赤身裸体地站在那儿。两人心情都很好，条件也都满足了。他们的身体连在一起。一对年轻夫妇的幸福圆满……至少看起来是这样。

可就在这时，那个刚刚失身，还用湿润的眼神看着他的女孩，突然变了。她嘴角上扬，邪恶地低声说道：“活该，亚子（笑）。”

主角惊讶地发现，这个女孩竟然是亚子的双胞胎妹妹，皆城澪。从姐姐那里引诱主角后，澪沉浸在优越感之中。相反，主角却因为误会了自己所爱的人而感到沮丧。

住在同一屋檐下的妹妹，偷偷想尽了书中的各种招数来引诱主角。姐姐对一些事情感到困惑，但对与男友半同居的想法感到兴奋。主角巧妙哄骗妹妹、提升与姐姐关系的日子即将开始。

[翻译自[url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/048/index.html]官网[/url]]
